notes.text: 3 opening(s) cut, 3 with a real frame seated in them. 15 row(s) across 2 cross-bonded layers, so the slab is rigid rather than loose plates. Floor laid under the walls: 32 plates in 2 layer(s). Window 1 x 2 x 3 Flat Front has no compiled pane in this build, so it is left unglazed. Door Frame 1 x 4 x 6 Type 2 has no compiled pane in this build, so it is left unglazed. Window 1 x 2 x 3 Flat Front has no compiled pane in this build, so it is left unglazed. Window 1 x 2 x 3 Flat Front has no compiled pane in this build, so it is left unglazed. Door Frame 1 x 4 x 6 Type 2 has no compiled pane in this build, so it is left unglazed. Window 1 x 2 x 3 Flat Front has no compiled pane in this build, so it is left unglazed. Corners interlock: the X walls and the Z walls alternate which runs full length each course.
